patches.summary: Top-level `login` command + interactive OAuth Client ID/Secret prompt fallback.
patches.reason: Generator's default auth UX requires --client-id / --client-secret flags or env vars on first invocation, with no interactive setup. New users would otherwise have to read the README to learn how to authenticate; the doctor hint pointed at a different env-var-based auth path that misled. This patch makes `<binary> login` discoverable at the root command, prompts for credentials when missing, and saves them so subsequent logins are zero-arg.
patches.validated_outcome: Fresh checkout with no env vars set: `./google-search-console-pp-cli login` prompts for Client ID with a console.cloud.google.com URL, runs OAuth, persists tokens. Second login on the same machine: zero prompts, browser opens, token refreshed.

upstream_tracking.note: Once the generator-side auth template lands the same UX, this patch can be dropped on the next regen of google-search-console.
